subject: Trial ops rituals, milestone owners, and kickoff logistics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Park <jared@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Trial ops rituals, milestone owners, and kickoff logistics

Hi Jared — great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Goal & success criteria (what Acme wants to validate in the 30-day trial)
- 99th perc. query latency under 220ms for average catalog queries (90th for complex queries)
- Embedding match accuracy: precision@10 > 0.78 on provided validation set
- End-to-end flow throughput: sustain ~200 qps for peak windows
- Integration: API + prefix caching working in Staging + automated telemetry to your APM

2) Proposed timeline (30-day cadence)
- Week 0 (kickoff): Nov 17 — environment access, baseline run, instrumentation
- Weeks 1–3: weekly 30-min check-ins (Wed 11:00 PT), focused milestone tests and data collection
- Week 4: final readout + decision meeting (Nov 16–20 window)

3) Owners & roles
- Redwood: Ben Carter (commercial lead), Marissa Cole (CS/onsite success), Olga Petrov (solutions eng, infra lead)
- Acme: Jared Park (product lead), Platform team (integration owner)

4) Ops rituals (what we'll run each week)
- Weekly sync: quick blockers, metric snapshot, next sprint items (30 min)
- Mid-week smoke test: run 1k synthetic queries, share logs
- Data handoff: validate test vectors and update acceptance metrics

5) Ask from Acme now
- Provide service account for staging (read/write) by Nov 12
- Share the validation set + baseline metrics (CSV)
- Any compliance gates (SOC2 evidence) we should prep for?

Attachments: POC-proposed-runbook.xlsx (detailed milestones + checklist), trial-checklist.pdf
Drive link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRunbook

If that looks good I’ll lock Nov 17 for kickoff and send calendar invites for the 30-min weekly syncs.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Jared Park <jared@acmeretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Platform Team <platform@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial ops rituals, milestone owners, and kickoff logistics

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few items and a couple of asks from our side: 

- We like the success metrics; two clarifications: precision@10 target should be validated on our sampling of recent searches (I’ll attach the CSV). Is there a tolerance band if we see initial variance?
- SOC2: we need a short evidence pack (typical items: data retention policy, access logs, encryption at rest) — can you share a pointer or attach a short PDF?
- Schedule: Nov 17 works for a kickoff. Would prefer the weekly syncs to be Thursdays at 10:30 PT if that’s possible.

I’m attaching the validation sample and a short security questionnaire.

—Jared
Jared Park | Sr. Product Manager, Search
Acme Retail
Attachments: validation-sample.csv, security-questions.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial ops rituals, milestone owners, and kickoff logistics

Looping in technical owners and flagging internal prep items: 
- Olga: can you confirm we have a staging tenant ready and that the runbook reflects a step to enable prefix caching and batch sizing tests?
- Operations: I’ll schedule the calendar series for weekly syncs (tentatively Thu 10:30 PT). Ben — please confirm when you want invites sent.
- Compliance: I can pull a SOC2 evidence bundle and a short note on retention policy. Estimated 48h to assemble.

Operational notes to include in runbook:
- Access checklist (service account + API key rotation steps)
- Baseline telemetry endpoints (prometheus, traces, token-level cost)
- Data handling instructions for Acme sample sets

I’ll also add a lightweight escalation path (SE -> CS -> AE) to the runbook.

Marissa

marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

- Olga — noted on the staging tenant. Can you validate the service account permissions and post confirm by EOD Monday (Nov 9)?
- Marissa — appreciate the SOC2 bundle, please post to the Drive link and I’ll share with Acme security.

Updated owners (for calendar invite):
- Customer success: Marissa Cole (redwood) / Jared Park (acme)
- Technical lead: Olga Petrov (redwood) / Platform Team (acme)
- Commercial owner: Ben Carter (redwood)

Next steps (action owner, due):

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRunbook

Thanks,
Ben
